# Build 30 — native notifications, optional imports, service messages and verification evidence

Base 0b98448426cba8d2f33f3ea667f8172cbd55364b. Version 0.1.0; develop only.

- 50 bilingual entries for background import progress, sprite rejection, data/launcher/guide timer/reference/update errors and notification availability. Settings and Home now render these recognized service strings without altering source payloads. Unknown provider strings and original English are preserved; dynamic field matching is restricted to known fields.
- Eight native entries cover tray-running hint, live/timer notification headers and accessible dismiss control. Native Qt code has not been executed in this environment.
- Added optional exact-known-English fallback capture to the existing three-language route/popout tests. Set `COMPANION_LOCALIZATION_FALLBACKS` to a local output directory when running the existing suite. Per-route/mode JSON reports text and accessibility attribute candidates with their catalog keys. No extra navigation or test matrix. This is a lower-bound candidate inventory: unknown English, dynamic/mixed strings, unopened dialogs and user/provider/brand exceptions still require context review. No fabricated coverage percentage.
- Actual assembled catalog: 2950 supplemental keys, 3040 merged. Changed JS syntax and fallback probe syntax passed, no duplicate keys or placeholder mismatches, 159 isolated error/progress checks passed. Browser regression added; Python/Qt and full Playwright suite not executed. Direct Git clone from this environment failed DNS resolution; native Windows/asset gates remain.
- Continue fast path: close remaining actual gaps, verify current candidate, quick performance smoke and targeted stabilization, then 0.8.0 friends-only closed alpha. No version bump, release or main merge.

## Item terminology and generated form identity follow-up

Shared item-category display helper now serves Item Library and linked entity picker; item evolution method tooltips use localized labels without inventing level/held-item data. Corrected the generator and checked-in Unown keys: all 28 invariant symbols have distinct entries in every language; unrelated terminology domains remain byte-equivalent in content. Corrected over-escaped regular expressions in the optional rendered fallback probe. Four added catalog keys; 2954 supplemental and 3044 merged. 162 isolated terminology cases, duplicate/placeholder and JS syntax checks passed. Generator was not rerun against external pinned CSVs; the checked-in form domain was updated directly, matching the new invariant rule. Full app verification remains pending.

## Quick performance smoke preparation

Added a developer-only process-tree resource sampler for Linux and Windows, with optional psutil (not a runtime dependency). Records short CPU and summed RSS measurements for idle, navigation, several popouts and recovery; output stays local. Tested the sampling function against a synthetic Python parent/child in the execution container, not the Companion itself. RSS may double-count shared pages, short-lived processes can be missed; cold startup, relaunch and quit remain manual observations. No native measurements or performance claim yet. Existing regression and clean-install checks remain the verification path; no extra large QA phase.

## Local verification and settings regression correction

Owner log for 04950e94aea20aa92926399a3e915d9f050e5851: initial regression 396 passed, 52 skipped, 179 browser setup errors (missing Chromium); clean install PASS, all 629 locations and 33,405 encounter rows reachable, zero broken IDs. After installing Chromium, UI suite reported 166 passed, 20 skipped, 16 failed. All 16 failures reported `t is not a function`; localization matrix pinpointed Settings → Windows & popouts. Root cause: `toolPrefCard(t, def, caps)` shadowed the imported translator `t`. Renamed its tool ID parameter to `toolId`, preserving every setting key and popout action. Actual source evaluated with stubbed DOM helpers for 51 tool/language combinations, verifying translated Open button, correct popout target, setting key and slider keys. Added focused browser regression for all three languages; repeat failed matrices on owner machine. No full rendered pass or percentage claim yet. No version bump or distribution.
